sourceChecks.text: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を読み、人物ではなく集団名の用法として確認。

sourceChecks.text: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を読み、人物ではなく集団名の用法として確認。

sourceChecks.text: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を読み、人物ではなく集団名の用法として確認。

sourceChecks.text: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を読み、人物ではなく集団名の用法として確認。

sourceChecks.text: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を読み、人物ではなく集団名の用法として確認。

sourceChecks.text: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.
